module: Career tutorial step 9 and last ("spmSignup"): the player accesses the garage computer, signs the hiring contract (contract popup, starting bonus of 10,000), opens the vehicle shop, chooses a seller, opens the purchase screen and buys their first vehicle. When it is added to the inventory, the v2/careerUnlocked popup is displayed, then career_modules_tutorial.endTutorial() is called. The tutorial vehicle is deleted when the purchase screen opens.
notes: Phases (strings): waitComputer, waitApmPopup, waitMarketplaceOpen, waitSellerSelect, waitPurchaseMenu, waitVehicleAdded, waitCareerUnlocked.

The STARTING_BONUS_MONEY = 10000 bonus is credited only once (tags tutorial/startingBonus), with a money sound; it is triggered when the contractSign popup closes or by onCareerTutorialRedeemedContractVoucher.
Unlocked achievements: WELCOME_TO_APM (signing), FIRST_ROLLOUT (end), EXTRA_CREDIT if career_modules_tutorial.playedAdvancedTimeTrial is true (field set dynamically by step 4).
The onVehicleShopping* and onVehicleAddedToInventory hooks are emitted by the career_modules_vehicleShopping module and the inventory.

setup.desc: Called on activation: resets the objectives, activates the garageBounds zone, gets the garageInteriorWalkStart and garageEntranceMarker spots, displays the "access the computer" objective and the entrance marker.

onComputerMenuOpened.desc: Hook emitted when the computer menu opens: validates the objective and opens the contract signing popup (user = current profile).

onUpdate.desc: Called every frame (waitComputer phase): hides the entrance marker within 3 m and clears the guidance path within 1 m of the walking start point.

onCareerTutorialRedeemedContractVoucher.desc: Hook emitted when the contract voucher is used: credits the starting bonus.

onIntroPopupCareerClosed.desc: Popup close hook: contractSign (bonus + achievement), v2/apmOnboarding (marketplace opening objective) and v2/careerUnlocked (achievement then end of the tutorial).

onVehicleShoppingMenuOpened.desc: Hook emitted when the vehicle shop opens: validates the objective and asks to choose a seller.

onVehicleShoppingSelectedSellerIdChanged.desc: Hook emitted when the selected seller changes: validates the objective and asks to open the purchase.

onVehicleShoppingPurchaseMenuOpened.desc: Hook emitted when the purchase screen opens: deletes the tutorial vehicle and displays the v2/vehiclePurchaseAndInsurance popup.

onVehicleAddedToInventory.desc: Hook emitted when a vehicle is added to the inventory: deactivates zones and reset, validates the final objective and displays the v2/careerUnlocked popup.

onGetRawPoiListForTutorial.desc: Adds the garage computer (servicestationGarageComputer facility) to the POI list during step 09spmSignup.

cleanup.desc: Removes the marker and money sound, clears zones, reset and task list.

onDebugMenu.desc: Displays the phase and a "Skip Step 9" button (validates all objectives and opens the careerUnlocked popup).
